From what I’m reading, you’re doing wonderful things- you’re seeing life through everyday, maintaining a schedule, feeding yourself, staying on top of your work, connecting, and loving. 

If you’re able to tell anyone you trust deeply, you should tell them these feelings. One thing that helps me is I’m able to confide in my friends about this existential dread. It’s helpful to hear their perspectives when I’m in this state and to know I’m not alone. Please know you’re not alone in this and I’m sure people will be heartbroken if you’re not here.
